pairs.statement: Insider Monkey reports that retailers are handling tariff refunds in very different ways, which counters Sony's argument that it should not have to pass on tariff refunds to customers.
pairs.why: The opposition highlights varied practices among retailers regarding tariff refunds, directly challenging Sony's assertion of a universal "should not have to" pass them on.

carriers.title: Retailers are Handling Tariff Refunds in Very Different Ways: Walmart and Home Depot

pairs.statement: Business Insider reports that video game makers generally do not want to provide tariff refunds to their customers, countering the PS5 buyers' claim that they are owed such refunds.
pairs.why: The opposition directly addresses the willingness of video game makers, including Sony, to provide tariff refunds, challenging the premise of the buyers' claim.
